reasons: CS4212 requires CS2104 or CS3212, neither of which is in the required list nor completed by the student, making it impossible to take CS4212 in Y4S2 as mandated.

CS4222 requires CS2105 (or EE courses) and ST2334 (or EE/MA courses). While ST2334 is taken in Sem 4, CS2105 is required. CS2105 requires CS2040S (completed) but also YSC2229 or CS2040 variants. The student has CS2040S. However, CS4222 also requires a second prerequisite from EE/MA list. The student has not completed any of EE2012A, EE2012, ST2131, ST2334, MA2116, MA2116T, MA2216. ST2334 is taken in Sem 4, so it can serve as the second prerequisite for CS4222 if CS4222 is taken in Sem 5 or later. But CS4222 is required. The main blocker is CS4212.

CS4236 is offered only in Sem 1. The student is starting Y2S2 (Sem 4). Sem 5 is the next Sem 1. CS4236 requires CS2107. The student has not completed CS2107, nor is it in the required list. Thus CS4236 cannot be taken unless CS2107 is added. But even if added, CS4212 remains impossible due to missing CS2104/CS3212.
